build_catapult_task_template: build a PHYRE task template that creates a catapult scene with randomized dimensions and a ball goal
create_task_with_define_task_template: create a task template using define_task_template decorator with seed range, version, and search parameters
add_box_with_virtual_tools: add a static box to the PHYRE scene using vt.add_box with position coordinates and flip_lr flag
add_container_goal: add a goal container to the PHYRE scene using vt.add_container with vertex list and thickness
add_multipolygons_dynamic_body: add a dynamic multi-polygon body like a catapult using C.add_multipolygons with converted vertex list
